## Description

Fixes for problems found by walking walk-in, queue TV, clinic overview, calendar views, reschedule/cancel, reminders and invitations on the deployed app. Eight small chunks, one per finding group, each testable on its own. Items that need a decision are marked in the scenarios.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The queue-display screen (/app/admin/displays) is reachable from Settings and the TV page tells staff where to find it; a display can be created, paired, shown and revoked.
- [ ] **AC2.** A cancelled appointment never covers the slot it freed, in mouse or keyboard use, and leaves the tab order immediately.
- [ ] **AC3.** Walk-in warns before checking the same patient in again, keeps the Next patients order consistent with token order, shows the token on success and validates the quick form as a whole.
- [ ] **AC4.** The schedule ruler matches the slot length, the selected date is in the address, and a stale appointment panel closes when the day or view changes.
- [ ] **AC5.** The access log does not drown in schedule and notification reads, and action names are translated.
- [ ] **AC6.** A reminder consent can be added after quick registration, and the visit panel says when reminders are scheduled.
- [ ] **AC7.** A revoked invitation reads clearly as revoked.
- [ ] **AC8.** Page loads do not sit on "Loading..." for seconds, and developer-facing text and plural slips are gone.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
